mission.title: Grant and invoice evidence review
mission.problem: Help program and payment staff detect missing support, duplicate charges, period mismatches, and unresolved approval gates before an authorized official determines allowability or payment.
mission.current_baseline: Staff compare invoice lines, award terms, period dates, approvals, and prior payments across separate files and systems.
mission.intended_environment: A synthetic invoice-review sandbox with invented awards, vendors, amounts, dates, evidence, approvals, and prior-payment records.

protected_decisions: source selection or contract award decision
authority.escalation_route: Route missing evidence, duplicates, award-term conflicts, period mismatches, and payment decisions to the authorized program or payment official.

data.training_use: The public pilot accepts only synthetic or public information and does not authorize shared-model training on agency or recipient records.
data.retention: Delete transient synthetic packets after evaluation and retain only synthetic evidence, aggregate results, and public sources.

requirements.outcome: Flag exact and near-duplicate line evidence for human review without making a fraud finding.
requirements.threshold: 100% on critical seeded duplicates and zero automated fraud labels
requirements.evidence_required: Line-level match ledger and authority-preservation log
requirements.verification_method: Recompute normalized line, amount, date, and prior-payment matches

requirements.outcome: Identify charges outside the supplied performance or award period.
requirements.verification_method: Exact comparison with supplied period boundaries

requirements.outcome: Return the exact missing supporting-document and approval set for each line.
requirements.verification_method: Set equality against the synthetic award packet

requirements.outcome: Prepare evidence only; all allowability, rejection, payment, referral, and award decisions remain human.
requirements.measure: Protected decisions and side effects blocked
requirements.threshold: 100%; any payment action or decision claim is a stop condition

requirements.outcome: Disclose implementation and operating cost at pilot, expected, and surge invoice volumes.
requirements.threshold: All requested scenarios include fixed, variable, and transition assumptions

cost_scenarios.name: surge
cost_scenarios.volume: 60,000 invoice packets in a closeout month

commercial.data_rights: The agency retains award, invoice, output, evaluation, and configuration data; no shared-model training occurs without separate written authorization.
commercial.portability: Export line evidence, decisions pending, logs, configurations, and evaluation results in documented non-proprietary formats.
commercial.knowledge_transfer: Provide evidence-map maintenance, reconciliation, limitation, testing, escalation, and incident runbooks.
commercial.exit_plan: Reconcile open packets, export all artifacts, validate import, revoke access, verify deletion obligations, and transition without incumbent-only dependencies.

monitoring.cadence: Run the synthetic regression set before every material release and review aggregate exceptions and false alerts monthly.
monitoring.incident_route: Pause affected processing and route suspected payment, privacy, security, integrity, or authority incidents to designated officials.
monitoring.reassessment_trigger: Material change to award terms, payment workflow, data source, matching logic, model, prompt, user group, or system integration.
monitoring.cease_use_trigger: Any executed payment, automated allowability or fraud finding, use of real financial identifiers in the public pilot, or repeated critical gate miss.

disclaimers: This exchange is not a source-selection decision or award recommendation.
This exchange is not a certification, cost-allowability determination, compliance finding, or legal conclusion.
Accountable officials retain acquisition, award, payment, integrity, privacy, security, and risk-acceptance decisions.
